scope: Ten previously open owner contracts; no maturity or authority promotion

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: normal-entry governance fault injection with canonical revision, projections, audit and receipt committed or rolled back together

owners.contract: Mutable governance history/receipt/head shares the caller connection; immutable policy/reference/scope producers retained; legacy past is UNKNOWN.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: ingestion fault injection across artifact, source spans, indexes, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Byte staging precedes DB publication; artifact/version/span/FTS/scope/binding publish or roll back together; exact IO and cleanup observations survive.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: acquisition and counter-search fault injection across observation, lead, claim, head, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Stage basis is immutable; current per-artifact source/span/predecessor is fenced at commit; explicit revalidation publishes freshly evaluated source IDs, retaining history and current access.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: criterion compile and correction fault injection across revision, profile projection, conflict, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Criterion revision/projection/conflict/reference/audit use current head CAS; inquiry and answer preserve source/authority; profile catalog is a separately atomic static cache.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: decision-object materialization fault injection across semantic revision, projections, head, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Candidate/object/head/audit/thread attachment are one accepted materialization checkpoint; HOLD candidate is valid; relations/attention/dependencies join the owner.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: hypothesis portfolio and appraisal fault injection across semantic revision, projections, head, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Generation batches, portfolio/auxiliary/prediction/appraisal/validity and normal-cycle identities retain exact canonical revisions; denied replay preserves its original operation.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: action portfolio, plan and authorization fault injection across semantic revision, projections, head, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Action/portfolio selection and plan publication share CAS/UoW; exact authorization is consumed once and rechecked against current roles/expiry/plan, without implicit new authority.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: execution and outcome fault injection across attempts, effects, observations, revisions, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Intent/IO/result/learning are separate phases; ambiguous dispatch remains UNKNOWN without replay or renewed budget; independent Outcome lifecycle remains execution-optional and type-bound.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: candidate evaluation, exposure, promotion and rollback fault injection with immutable baseline preservation

owners.contract: Evaluation reservation, arm IO, scoring, exposure and pointer/receipt publication are distinct; immutable baselines and in-flight snapshots persist; missing summaries recover exact committed runs.

historical_debt.closure_evidence_required: closure and export fault injection across snapshot, package, manifest, release state, audit and receipt

owners.contract: Closure/open-item dispositions and frozen export rights remain current; file staging is outside DB; single-record retention/purge preparation uses its own transaction and never deletes/transmits.
